item.title: github: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Actions workflow dependency lockfiles are now in public preview for GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, Team, and Free plans. They let workflows pin dependencies more reliably even if tags or branches later move.

  • Source: GitHub
